notes: Nothing the agent says disappears any more. Anything it said before running another command used to be deleted from the chat, so a question it asked and then kept working past erased itself. A question now gets clickable answers that stay, and that carry the question with them. Creating a project no longer offers to build it inside the project you are in, and new projects go in the folder you chose rather than a hidden one. The wall between the chat and the viewer can actually be grabbed.
